long_description:
# Facebook / Messenger / Threads MCP Server

Connect Claude to your Facebook account, Messenger inbox, Groups, and Threads with an MCP server backed by cookie-based web scraping (the same approach as instagram-lyr). Authenticate once by importing cookies from your browser (`facebook-lyr --login`) or set `FACEBOOK_COOKIES` for headless agents — no Graph API app, no token generation, no browser automation.

## Quick start

1. Install: `install.sh` (or `uv sync`)
2. Authenticate: `facebook-lyr --login` (import cookies from your browser)
3. Verify: `facebook-lyr --status`
4. Start the MCP server: `facebook-lyr`

## First-time auth flow

1. Log into facebook.com in your browser (complete any 2FA/checkpoint).
2. Run `facebook-lyr --login` and pick your browser — the session cookies (`c_user` + `xs`) are extracted from the browser's cookie store and saved to `~/.facebook-lyr/profile/cookies.json` (0600).
3. Retry any tool once auth is configured.

For headless AI agents, set the `FACEBOOK_COOKIES` environment variable to a JSON object containing at least `c_user` and `xs` — no interactive step needed.
